title: Restricted Projections to Hyperplanes in $\mathbb{R}^n$
summary: We study dimensions of sets projected to an $(n-2)$-dimensional family of hyperplanes in $\mathbb{R}^n$ under curvature conditions. Let $n\ge 3$ and $Σ\subset S^{n-1}$ be an $(n-2)$-dimensional $C^2$ manifold such that $Σ$ has non-vanishing geodesic curvature ($n=3$)/sectional curvature $>1$ ($n \ge 4)$. Let $Z \subset \mathbb{R}^{n}$ be analytic with $\dim Z \le n-2$ and $0 n-2$, if in addition $π_{T_yS^{n-1}}(Z) \le n-2$ for some $y \in S^{n-1}$, we show that $\dim π_{T_xS^{n-1}}(Z) = \min\{\dim Z, n-1\}$ for $\mathcal{H}^{n-2}$-a.e. $x \in Σ$.
